key.name: shortcut
key.description: Global keyboard shortcut used to open or dismiss the palette.

key.name: model-endpoint
key.description: Endpoint for the configured local model provider.

key.name: model-provider
key.description: Backend-neutral provider identifier used by the local provider registry.

key.name: model-quick-writing
key.description: Configurable model for short text transformations.

key.name: model-intent-routing
key.description: Small model used only when deterministic parsing cannot map a query to a registered system action.

key.name: model-assistant
key.description: Configurable model for explanations and summaries.

key.name: model-reasoning
key.description: Configurable model for questions requiring deeper reasoning.

key.name: enable-passive-writing
key.description: Offer local corrections after a completed sentence and typing pause in supported editable fields.

key.name: passive-tab-accept
key.summary: Use Tab for visible corrections in supported prose editors

key.name: retain-learning-examples
key.summary: Save accepted and edited text examples locally
key.description: Requires personalization. Retain short source, suggestion and final edits for a future local dataset. Turning this off deletes saved examples.

key.name: enable-learning
key.description: Store action names and accepted or rejected outcomes locally, without text.

key.name: enable-predictive-writing
key.description: After a typing pause in supported multiline GTK editors, offer a short continuation as subdued ghost text near the caret. Tab accepts it, Right accepts one word, Escape dismisses. Off by default.

key.name: save-intelligence-history
key.description: Keep completed Ask Intelligence conversations in a local database on this computer. Turning this off keeps new Ask interactions temporary; existing history is only removed through Clear Intelligence History.
